summary: BioLineRx Ltd. filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) attaching a September 10, 2026 press release announcing that two GLIX1 abstracts were accepted for presentation at EANO 2026, held September 24-27 in Rome. The company and collaborator Hemispherian AS will present preclinical efficacy data in orthotopic glioblastoma models and the design of an actively enrolling first-in-human Phase 1/2a trial (NCT07464925). No stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or transaction mechanics were disclosed; this is a routine scientific/clinical milestone disclosure, not a special situation. Watch for subsequent deal or financing announcements, not this filing.
